text:
Asha: Heads-up — compact compare feels cramped when multiple facets are toggled. Filter rail chews space and the hierarchy is hard to scan.
Tom: Agreed. Proposal: auto-show top 3 values per facet + a small counter '+4' that opens the full list inline. That preserves context.
Priya: If we hide too much, first-time users won't discover filters. Maybe show a condensed summary bar above the list: 'Filters: model type=decoder, quant=4-bit, region=us-west' with an edit button.
Jorge: On badges: cost/perf chips have low contrast on the neutral surface. Current color #6B6B6B on #F3F3F3 gives ~3.2:1. Need >=4.5:1 for body text.
Maya: Copy note: replace 'p95' with 'Latency (95th)' in the badge. Also include unit in tooltip 'ms' and a short example query.
Sasha: Pin action ambiguity: users think pin attaches to the model, not the variant. Suggest label change: pin icon + small text 'version' on hover and show a persistent banner when a version is pinned: 'Pinned: model-name @ v2'.
Tom: a11y: pin button must be in tab order, aria-label='Pin version for comparison' and aria-pressed toggles. When pinned, announce via aria-live: 'Version pinned: v2'.
Priya: CTA tweaks: change 'Compare' -> 'Compare selected (up to 5)' and swap 'Select all' to 'Select visible' for clarity with pagination.
Maya: Layout tweak: compact rows should allow 2-line wrapping for long model names. Add 6px vertical padding so badge overlays don't collide.
Asha: Microcopy options for badge tooltip: (A) 'Latency 95th percentile — 120 ms (lower is better)' (B) '95th percentile latency: 120 ms' Which feels clearer?
Jorge: Pick B. It's consistent with dashboards.
Sasha: tiny CSS for focus ring suggestion: .r-focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,111,235,0.18); border-radius: 6px; }
DesignBot: Reminder: upload updated frames to Figma and tag @design-review. Deadline: Thu EOD. Link: https://figma.redwood/mock
Tom: Accessibility test plan: keyboard-only path for filter -> pin -> compare should be <5 keys. Can someone prototype the tab sequence?
Priya: I'll record a quick Loom of a keyboard flow tomorrow AM.
Maya: Also add aria-live polite when compare table refreshes: 'Compare updated — 3 models compared'.
Asha: Action list: 1) Priya — loom of keyboard flow; 2) Design — Figma edits (labels, badge contrast, pin banner); 3) Eng — aria attrs + focus styles + change CTA text; 4) Copy — finalize tooltip text (Jorge prefers B).
Sasha: :+1:
Priya: Will post Loom link here when done.
Asha: Thanks — I'll bring the mock to Friday's sync for sign-off.
